## Appearance

Honora is a fair, pale, and ethereal-appearing young woman with exquisite light hair. She is tall, exceeding Cressida Lindsay by a solid two inches in height. Nell described her soul as resembling a golden narcissus, while her husband gushed over her ethereal, golden beauty.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P70](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0070), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Honora is contemplative, creative, and driven, yet packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She possesses a dreamy nature and a strong appreciation for beauty and poetry, though she can also be candid and firm about household rules. She is deeply affectionate toward her close friends and shares their imaginative perspective on life.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v3 c4 P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070), [v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056)_

## History

Honora attended Regent's Academy, where she formed a tight friendship with Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby. After school, she was assigned to teach at the Delford school and contributed an essay to the Brierley Village Improvement Society. Later, she enrolled at Wexcombe alongside Nell, where they roomed together and became close with Cressida Lindsay. With Nell and Mabel, she leased 'Tabby's Place' on Linden Avenue, living under the care of Mabel's Aunt Euphemia. At Wexcombe, she earned Honors in Classics upon graduation. She subsequently married a handsome foreign missionary and relocated to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), [v3 c10 P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 c16 P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_
